signal: Hexmodal, a smart emergency lighting and monitoring startup backed by NextFab Ventures, is scaling its cloud monitoring platform to new commercial buildings

email.body1:
Taylor, Hexmodal turning emergency lighting into a connected, cloud-monitored platform is a sharp wedge into commercial buildings.

As the early team pushes into new accounts, there are usually more facilities and partners worth pursuing than BD can work before momentum fades, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Hexmodal off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Taylor, quick follow-up for Hexmodal.

At an early growth stage, the number usually climbs faster than a small BD team can cover. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Hexmodal needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Taylor, last bit of proof for Hexmodal.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Hexmodal's reply rate likely compares to other early-stage hardware and IoT teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Taylor, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and the early growth stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an early-stage BD motion? I will tailor it to Hexmodal either way.
